content_text: In that kind of situation I would judge my exposure from the ambient light, setting my stop where I wanted the daylight to fall. The practical level and any other detail I would judge by eye. But there are many ways to judge exposure and mine is just one. Other cinematographers might use a spot meter, which can produce a quite exact reading if used correctly.
